sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the lilies work (2026-10-18): every character from the floras in the lilies notes (plantgen-claude project-files/lilies/SOURCES.md), drawn by the rules its taxa hold; drawing values only where no character says them.

taxon.note: WCVP v16 accepted name Lilium pumilum, plant_name_id 279815.

growth_form.note: A bulbous herb with one leafy flowering stem a year, drawn by the forb form.

growth.note: Grown five years from seed, as a lily bulb takes three to five to flower; drawn at its third and fifth years.

variants.note: One seed in the open, as the built-in species.

allometry.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium pumilum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stem 15-60 cm; Bailey (as L. tenuifolium, p. 1874): 1-2 ft high, slender. Its reference height is the middle of that range, 0.38 m, at its last keyframe.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium pumilum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stem 15-60 cm; Bailey (as L. tenuifolium, p. 1874): 1-2 ft high, slender.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium pumilum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves scattered near middle of stem.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium pumilum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves linear, 3.5-9 cm long; Bailey: 1-2 in long, 40-60 of them.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium pumilum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves linear, 1.5-3 wide; the online text prints cm, read as mm, as 'linear' and Bailey's fern-leaved lily say.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium pumilum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves linear, midvein prominent abaxially.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 4 (1916), Lilium tenuifolium, p. 1874 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-18): flowers 1-15; Flora of China: solitary or several in a raceme. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.flower_posture.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium pumilum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowers nodding.

traits.perianth_reflexion.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium pumilum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): tepals revolute; Bailey: waxy segments reflexed to the stem.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium pumilum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): tepals bright red; Bailey: brilliant scarlet, the brightest in colour of all. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.perianth_spots.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium pumilum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): usually unspotted, occasionally with a few spots near base; Bailey: rarely slightly dotted purple.

traits.tepal_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium pumilum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): tepals 4-4.5 cm x 8-11 mm.

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium pumilum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): filaments 1.2-2.5 cm, anthers ca. 1 cm, short of the 4-4.5 cm tepals.

traits.anther_colour.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium pumilum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): anthers yellow, with reddish pollen; Bailey gives anthers scarlet or red. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium pumilum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsule oblong, ca. 2 x 1.2-1.8 cm.

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium pumilum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsule 1.2-1.8 cm wide.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium pumilum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowering Jul-Aug; Bailey (in gardens): June, early July.

traits.fruiting_months.note: Flora of China vol. 24, Lilium pumilum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): fruit Sep-Oct.
